description: Owns reusable HarmonyOS application delivery practice and evaluation.

HarmonyOS Stage-model application or module configuration

compatibility.statement: Compatible with Harness Kernel protocol 1.0. Version 5.0.0 makes the business module's models/ boundary mandatory for request, response and other pure data definitions, limits its api/ boundary to endpoint declarations, repository contracts and implementations, and HTTP-facing services, and removes the 4.0.0 feature-owned transport and official-SDK adapter fallback. It retains deterministic typed request outcomes, sensitive-evidence redaction, State Management V2, page/Dialog classification, UI-resource, meaningful Chinese-comment, provider-direction, and Kernel authorization controls. Projects may remain pinned to 4.x; migration to 5.0.0 applies the new placement and no-local-transport rules only to new or materially changed request/response models and their direct API dependency chains, does not move unrelated legacy files, and blocks dependent network implementation when neither a supplied tool nor an established exported project network capability can be verified.
